_note: Batch 6: ten REAL Perth energy-healing practices researched from public information on 8 Aug 2026. Introduces the 'energy' practice category (created on import) covering reiki, pranic healing, chakra balancing, crystal, shamanic and spiritual healing, and aura/energy clearing. Original blurbs, all unclaimed, no copied ratings. Copy is strictly descriptive — modality, sessions, prices, hours and qualifications only; no therapeutic or outcome claims anywhere. Several practices are home studios listed at suburb level (noted per _source).

listings.name: The Crystal Garden
listings.blurb: Renato, a Usui Reiki Master and crystal energy healing practitioner, runs sessions from his Bull Creek rooms combining reiki with crystal and light work. Initial consultations run up to ninety minutes, follow-ups an hour, and clients stay fully clothed throughout. Crystal light beds are also available to rent or buy. Open Thursday to Saturday.
listings._source: thecrystalgarden.com.au — full address, phone, email, hours, practitioner qualifications confirmed; prices not published

listings.name: Happy Mind Body and Soul
listings.blurb: Mandi Kelly holds a Master Reiki qualification and an Advanced Diploma in Clinical Hypnotherapy, working from a private healing room on South Terrace. Sessions span reiki, reiki hot- and cold-stone massage, crystal and sound healing, hypnotherapy and past-life regression, with Reiki Level 1 and 2 training courses that took a Fremantle Chamber of Commerce award in 2023.
listings._source: happymindbodyandsoul.com.au — address, phone, email, qualifications, award confirmed; prices and hours not published

listings.name: Kuantika Quantum Healing
listings.blurb: A shamanic practice in Hilton working with soul retrieval, ancestral and past-life clearing, and light language, in person or remotely over Zoom. Prices are stated plainly: $200 for a ninety-minute initial session and $160 for seventy-five-minute follow-ups. Workshops in light language run through the year.
listings._source: kuantika.com.au — suburb (home studio), phone, email, full session prices ($200 initial / $160 follow-up) confirmed; practitioner name and hours not published

listings.name: Chakra Harmony Reiki Perth
listings.blurb: Gayle is a Usui/Holy Fire III Karuna Reiki Master, practitioner and teacher with more than eighteen years in mental-health and disability support work. From her Hillarys treatment room she offers sixty-to-ninety-minute reiki sessions, sound therapy and property energy clearing, plus reiki courses. Clients remain clothed throughout. Open 10am to 5pm.
listings._source: chakraharmonyreikiperth.com.au — suburb (home studio), phone, email, hours, certifications confirmed; prices not published

listings.name: Light Divine Wellness Centre
listings.blurb: Eileen is an intuitive Reiki Master, certified sound therapy practitioner and certified Activator healer-coach in quantum and dimensional healing. Her City Beach practice offers intuitive reiki in person or at distance, sound healing, and tarot readings — singly or combined — with gift vouchers available.
listings._source: lightdivine.com.au — suburb, phone, email, certifications confirmed; prices and hours not published

listings.name: The Peace Practice
listings.address: Mount Lawley WA 6050 (studio address shared on booking)
listings.blurb: Elaine MacLeod has run The Peace Practice since 2016, working in the Usui/Holy Fire and Karuna Reiki systems from her Mount Lawley studio. One-to-one reiki sessions run in person or at distance, alongside reiki training workshops, space clearing, and reiki-infused meditation mini-courses. Bookings are online; gift vouchers available.
listings._source: thepeacepractice.com.au — suburb, practitioner, est. 2016, Usui/Holy Fire & Karuna systems confirmed; street address on booking only, phone/email/prices not published

listings.name: Angel Light Heart and Soul Healing
listings.blurb: Euphemia teaches small-group workshops from Hamilton Hill: Reiki levels one to three ($200–$390), a six-week Awaken & Raise Your Vibration course ($320), a reiki and chakra balancing weekend ($350) and a $30 pendulum workshop, with online meditation and journaling at $10 a week. Healing sessions include sound meditation, clairvoyant readings and aura drawings.
listings._source: angellight.com.au — suburb, practitioner, full workshop price list confirmed; phone, email and street address not published

listings.name: Perth Reiki
listings.blurb: Kristina Ritchie pairs Reiki I and II certification with diplomas in remedial massage, remedial therapies, herbal medicine, naturopathy and mind/body psychotherapy. Her Fremantle practice offers reiki at $120 an hour ($170 for ninety minutes), intuitive counselling and coaching from $120, and remote sessions by Zoom or phone.
listings._source: perthreiki.com.au — suburb, phone, full price list ($120–$180), qualifications confirmed; street address, email and hours not published

listings.name: Ashati Institute of Energy Healing
listings.blurb: A training school running for over twenty years with more than four thousand students through its doors, teaching Reiki 1 and 2 and its own Ashati and Alsemia energy-healing systems from city venues on Mounts Bay Road and Barrack Street. The full practitioner program is $1,540 paid up front or about $266 per workshop on a plan, alongside healing sessions and intuitive development training.
listings._source: ashati.org — both city venue addresses, course pricing ($1,540 / $266 per workshop), 20+ years operating confirmed; phone and instructor names not published

listings.name: Pranic Healing Perth
listings.blurb: The Western Australian licensee for Master Choa Kok Sui's pranic healing system, affiliated with the Institute for Inner Studies. Runs pranic healing sessions and the full course ladder — Basic through Advanced, Pranic Psychotherapy, Psychic Self Defence, Feng Shui and Crystal levels — plus weekly Meditation on Twin Hearts and monthly full-moon meditations at venues around Perth.
listings._source: pranichealingperth.com — phone, email, course ladder, licensee status confirmed; venue addresses vary per event, prices not published
